moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-karaoke-fill, written here): Line 30 px weight 800, white with a 4 px dark outline. Word times from the transcript (demo: split 0.4–3.6 s by word length). Each word's accent copy (same outline) is revealed by a clip growing left → right linearly over exactly its own duration, clamped, and stays filled; a 1 px ink line marks the fill edge while it moves. Fade out 4.2–4.5 s. Loop 4.8 s. ASS equivalent: \kf in centiseconds. Params: thời điểm từng từ (theo lời) · màu tô (nhấn) · viền chữ (4 px).
